cc:Work.dc:title: First-index and re-index time
cc:Work.dc:description: Same two-panel logarithmic scatter style: repository dots and median bars, seeded horizontal jitter. Trace refreshed using the frozen start-of-run build with fresh Trace caches and the original 13 pinned repositories and protocol. Later concurrent source edits are excluded. Other tools retain historical timings, not a contemporaneous comparison. One timing per repository/phase; preinstalled dependencies and warm OS caches; one-line edit appends a newline. No significance or equivalent analysis-coverage claim.
